goal: Implement typed Callisto-owned release-PR decisions and make the GitHub composite action a verified executor.

steps.description: Add strict versioned release-PR snapshot/config/decision types and pure deterministic decision derivation in callisto-model.
Add read-only `callisto release-pr decide`, loading workspace status and rendering its typed decision as JSON.
steps.commit: feat(cli): decide managed release PR operations

steps.description: Replace shell-side policy discovery with snapshot collection, CLI decision invocation, expected-state rechecks, and closed decision execution.
steps.commit: feat(action): execute Callisto release PR decisions

steps.description: Map every acceptance criterion to mutation-resistant Rust, CLI, and exact-action black-box tests.
steps.commit: test(release): verify release PR decision contract

final_acceptance: Do not mark the spec accepted until every acceptance criterion has a named passing test, the exact GitHub action contract is green on GitHub, and no action path independently derives create/update/supersede policy.
